english: ...So the magical yo-yo is\na special weapon that split long ago\ninto a toy and a striking art, desuu.
It evolved into a weapon,\nan assassination art rooted in taking on\none to many opponents, desuu.
Oooh~. I don't really get it, but\none thing's clear: it's amazing!
And then, back in the age of magic civilization,\nthey mixed in magic for even more advanced techniques...
She said she was shy with strangers, but\nlooks like they've become\nfast friends...
Hey, [MERU].\nMeeting in a totally unknown world-\nI think that's fate.
It'd be amazing if we became friends!
Um, if someone like me\nis okay, desuu...
Likewise, if I'm okay with you!
Yes, desuu!
Ehehe... I'm happy.
...Come to think of it, Hibiki,\nwhat was that job you mentioned, desuu?
Huh...?
That outfit's a school uniform, right?\nWhat kind of job is it, desuu?
Ahh~, w-well, that's...
It's a secret, desuu...?
Umm...
// Remu returns.
Sorry to keep you.\nI heard what the police station had to say.
Welcome back, Remu.\nAny leads?
Long story short, that headless corpse\npredates the dream demons.
So the 'sudden street-sleeping incidents'\naren't the dream demons' doing.
What a horrible case... innocent people...
H-horrible, desuu...
The killer's extremely dangerous.\nProbably thinks nothing of murder...
(Even as far as I know, there are only\na handful that dangerous...)
Remu, um... how did\nthe 'searching for someone' request go, desuu?
Ah, about whether [MERU]'s teacher\ncame to this world-\nno matching person confirmed yet.
Uuuuh, too bad, desuu...
But I gave a sketch to Inspector Sakaki,\nand arranged for them to contact me\nas soon as they spot someone matching.
Thank you, desuu!
Good for you, [MERU]!
Anyway, tons to investigate.\nWe've got to get out there and dig.
Hibiki,\ndo you know where\nyou appeared in this world?
Yes! So I wouldn't get lost,\nI memorized the place!\n...I don't think there's anything there, though.
Doesn't hurt to check-let's go look!
// Scene change\n// Background: town at night
Doesn't look like anything's here, desuu.
...Hmm.\nI'd hoped there'd be some\ntraces that could be clues, but...
After all, it was just a light...
Light doesn't leave traces.\nIf only we could see\nthat phenomenon again.
...Hm? Hibiki, did you say something, desuu?
Huh? I didn't say anything?
I heard a weird sound, desuu.
Eh, was that my stomach?\nHow embarrassing~.
After all that food, you're still hungry?
Doesn't sound like\nHibiki's stomach, though.
// Noise appears
Th-that's a Noise!?
No way!? Why!?
Take this!!
// SFX: gunshot\n// Remu attacks with her gun, but no damage.
It took silver dum-dum rounds and didn't go down!?\nYou're saying it's not a demon!?
Stay back, Remu!
// Hibiki steps forward
Hibiki, it's dangerous, desuu!
Um! Looks like I can repay you\nfor the meal sooner than I thought!
Huh?
// Battle map: town (night)
// She transforms in the light
Alright, I can do this.
That is... desuu!?
Haaaaaah!!
Singing...!
[MERU],\nsorry I couldn't say it before!\nTHIS is my job!
That's a Noise.\nIt's the enemy I must fight\nwith this Gungnir Symphogear! Everyone, run!
W-we'll fight too, desuu!
No!
Umm, Hibiki's song becomes a barrier\nand protects us, right?
Huh? How do you know that?
Doesn't look like there's time to chat.\nHere they come!
// ■ Battle start
Yes! It worked, desuu!
Wow, [MERU]'s\nreally strong.\nHuh? But that's weird...
The song's barrier effect aside,\na Noise taking damage from something\nother than a Symphogear attack...???
Using yo-yo techniques on\nsuch cute little ones...\nI really hate it, desuu...
No no! But right now I've got no choice, desuu!
Hm?
([MERU] doesn't want to fight...?)
Mugugu... with my ultimate technique,\nsending them to heaven is the least mercy I can show, desuu!!
(Don't really get it, but she's fired up!?)
// Defeat a set number of Noise
At this rate we might pull through!
Yes, but it looks like we've got other guests.
// Black Sonico appears
Fufufu...
Um... hmm?\nHaven't I seen her somewhere...?
Aaaah!\nI recognize those headphones, desuu.
But her aura's different from that girl...\nSo the doppelganger's graced us?
Is that even human...?
Let's do our best at the shoot today, okay?\nFufufu...
No! No hesitation-do it well! Me!
// Battle continues\n// Deal set damage to Black Sonico
See you later, okay?
// Black Sonico exits
(Good, she left...)
She got away...\nBut our hands are full right now too.
// ■ Battle over
Fuu. For now, I feel relieved?
Defeated safely! Sei!
Hawawawa, what's that pose, desuu?
In martial arts it's called zanshin-\nyou do it to stay alert, but\nI also do it 'cause it looks cool... ehehe.
It feels great,\n[MERU], you try it too!
Huh? Me, desuu?
I wanna see it. Please!
Uu, it's embarrassing, I can't, desuu!!
Still, I'm surprised.\nThat Hibiki had such power.
Sorry I kept quiet.\nThis power is classified...
But how did [MERU]\nknow about the song?\nNormally you'd be shocked to see someone fight while singing...
Huh? Didn't I tell you\nabout Tsubasa?
Tsubasa... you mean Tsubasa Kazanari!?
That's right, desuu. Actually, before meeting you, Hibiki...
// Fade to black: time passes.\n// Background: town at night
...I see, I see.\nYou came to this world with Tsubasa.
Come to think of it, no word from them, but\nthey said they'd come to the office later, right?
No word for too long, desuu.\nI'm worried [NOEL] might be\ncausing trouble...
While we were out,\ndid we just miss each other, I wonder?
Let's go see them!\nI want to see Tsubasa too!
What if that light\nwhisked them off somewhere again...?
// Light appears
Hahaha, joking again.
Wait, huh!?
D-did I say something weird...?
Remu, run, desuu!\nWe'll end up in a weird world!!
(Should I stay behind? No-to solve the mystery...!)
...Well, let's go!\nI don't hate thrills and adventure♪
// Enveloped in light, they move
